lead: Ten of the 91 watchlist names had confirmed announcements in the window, led by Saturn Metals' A$100 million two-tranche placement at A$0.40 per share (an 11.1% discount) to fund construction readiness at Apollo Hill, alongside high-grade drill hits at Tolu Minerals' Tolukuma mine, Asara Resources' Kada project and Toubani Resources' quarterly, plus a Pacgold trading halt pending a capital raising announcement.

rows.announcement: Retracted three undisclosed rock chip samples

summaries.heading: Saturn Metals raises $100m at $0.40 to fund Apollo Hill construction readiness
summaries.body: Saturn Metals secured firm commitments for a $100 million two-tranche placement at $0.40 per share, an 11.1% discount to last close of $0.450. New cornerstone Golden Crane Holdings is committing approximately $48.6 million for 121.5 million shares, expected to reach roughly 15% of the company. A non-underwritten $5 million SPP follows, with Tranche Two's $75 million requiring shareholder approval on 17 September 2026. Funds target front end engineering, long lead items and construction readiness at Apollo Hill, following a 26% resource upgrade to 2.83Moz.

summaries.heading: Tolu Minerals extends high-grade hits at Tolukuma ahead of August MRE
summaries.body: Tolu Minerals reported assays from 17 new diamond holes at Tolukuma, headlined by 3.9m at 42.35g/t Au from 84.1m (TUD-26-013) and 2.0m at 32.01g/t Au from 20.0m plus 1.0m at 37.54g/t Au from 149.0m (TSD-26-030). The revised geological model now recognises 44 mineralised veins and splays, up from 15, lifting interpreted vein volume by about 15%. Results feed an updated Mineral Resource Estimate due late August 2026, ahead of targeted first production in Q1 2027.

summaries.heading: Asara Resources hits high-grade gold in maiden southern fence drilling at Massan
summaries.body: Asara Resources returned 47m at 8.0g/t Au from 10m (MSRC26-167), including 8m at 42.2g/t Au, plus 66m at 0.7g/t Au from 84m (MSRC26-154) and 19m at 2.1g/t Au from 105m (MSRC26-151), from first-pass drilling south of the Massan centre at Kada. Hole MSRC26-167 also returned two consecutive 1m intervals grading over 130g/t Au. Results confirm mineralisation extending into a previously under-drilled southern extension ahead of an August 2026 MRE update.

summaries.heading: Pacgold halted pending capital raising announcement
summaries.body: Pacgold is halted pending an announcement regarding a capital raising, with trading to resume the earlier of normal trading on Friday 31 July 2026 or release of the announcement.

summaries.heading: GoldArc retracts undisclosed rock chip samples from Yttria announcement
summaries.body: GoldArc Resources retracted three rock chip samples reported in its 27 July 2026 announcement on the Yttria Aircore Project after failing to disclose information required under ASX Listing Rules 5.6 and 5.7. The company says the samples are surface reconnaissance material not required to support the drilling results, and the drilling results themselves remain unchanged.

quarterlies.headline: FY26 accounts: cash builds to C$81.2m, net loss C$40.4m on higher exploration spend
quarterlies.summary: Benz Mining closed FY26 with cash of C$81.2 million (+C$69.5m YoY) after raising C$96.6m in equity, against a net loss of C$40.4 million driven by C$38.8 million exploration and evaluation costs; exploration and evaluation assets carried at C$15.1 million.

quarterlies.headline: June quarter: Kobada construction 61% committed, $302m funding package secured
quarterlies.summary: Toubani advanced Kobada construction to 61% of capex committed, with process plant engineering over 60% and power plant 70% complete; cash at quarter end was A$73.5 million. Subsequent to quarter end it executed a US$160m gold stream with Eagle Eye Asset and a fully underwritten A$70m equity raising, taking pro forma cash to A$144 million. Also acquired a 19.9% stake in Avanti Gold Corp via share swap.

quarterlies.headline: Skylark completes Phase 1 M'Basso drilling, extends strike to 750m
quarterlies.summary: Skylark completed 38 RC holes for 6,667m at M'Basso, best intercept 62m at 1.41g/t Au from 114m, extending RC-defined strike to approximately 750m; cash at 30 June 2026 was A$4.85 million. Exercised option to acquire 100% of Vavoua Project for A$150,000. Metallurgical testwork on 16 samples averaged 95% LeachWELL gold extraction.

watch_items: Pacgold (PGO) halted pending a capital raising announcement, expected by the commencement of normal trading on 31 July 2026 or earlier release
Toubani Resources (TRE) retail entitlement offer component (~A$18m) closes 3 August 2026, with Eagle Eye Asset gold stream drawdown expected Q3 2026
Tolu Minerals (TOK) updated Mineral Resource Estimate for Tolukuma due late August 2026
Asara Resources (AS1) updated MRE for Kada expected following an internal drilling cut-off ahead of August 2026
Saturn Metals (STN) Tranche Two of its placement ($75m) requires shareholder approval at a general meeting on 17 September 2026
day_in_brief: The most material development was Saturn Metals' strongly supported $100 million placement at $0.40 per share, an 11.1% discount, bringing in cornerstone investor Golden Crane Holdings for roughly 15% of the company to fund Apollo Hill construction readiness. Elsewhere, drilling news dominated: Tolu Minerals reported 3.9m at 42.35g/t Au among further high-grade Tolukuma intercepts ahead of a late-August resource update, and Asara Resources returned 47m at 8.0g/t Au including 8m at 42.2g/t Au from newly drilled southern fence lines at Kada. Toubani Resources' quarterly confirmed a A$302 million funding package (US$160m gold stream plus A$70m equity) to complete Kobada construction, now 61% committed. Pacgold remains halted pending a capital raising announcement, and GoldArc retracted undisclosed rock chip data from its Yttria announcement without affecting the underlying drilling results.
subtitle: Saturn Metals' $100m raise and a run of high-grade gold assays across Tolu, Asara and Toubani dominate an active session; Pacgold remains halted into a capital raising.
